title: Zomato Lays Off 250 Employees, Closes Hyderabad Customer Support Center
summary: Food delivery company Zomato has laid off approximately 250 employees and closed its customer support center in Hyderabad. This decision comes as part of a restructuring of its customer support operations. The company has not provided further details on the restructuring or the reasons behind the layoffs beyond operational changes.
summary_points: Zomato has laid off around 250 employees.
The company has shut down its customer support center in Hyderabad.
The layoffs are part of a restructuring of customer support operations.
No further details on the restructuring have been provided by the company.

summary_points_hi: जोमैटो ने लगभग 250 कर्मचारियों को निकाला है।
कंपनी ने हैदराबाद में अपना ग्राहक सहायता केंद्र बंद कर दिया है।
छंटनी ग्राहक सहायता कार्यों के पुनर्गठन का हिस्सा है।
